sections.body: Red 🔴, yellow 🟡 and blue 🔵 are special paint colours.
Mix them and you make NEW colours! 🎨
Yellow + blue = green 🟢. Red + yellow = orange 🟠. Red + blue = purple 🟣.
With a grown-up, mix two paint colours on paper. What did you make?
Washable paints or coloured water in clear cups work well. Let them predict first: 'What do you think will happen?'

hints: Think of the colour of grass.
Leaves on trees are this colour too.
Red + yellow makes orange 🟠, like an orange fruit. What colour are leaves? 🍃
Think of a fruit with the same name as a colour.
Yellow + blue makes green, like grass. Red + yellow makes the colour of a carrot!
